Located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the '''Ruan system''' contained one of the eighteen farming planets administered by the [[Salliche Agricultural Corporation|Salliche Ag Corporation]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], workers in the [[Yulant system/Legends|Yulant]], Ruan, and [[Broest system/Legends|Broest systems]] revolted against the Imperially-controlled Salliche Ag by burning fields and destroying hydroponics facilities.<ref name="TCSWE" />
